verdict.rationale: Snyk ships an official, open-source CLI (snyk/cli) for testing open-source dependencies, code, IaC, containers and secrets, usable locally, in IDEs and in CI/CD. It has AI-native features: `snyk fix --agentic` runs interactive LLM remediation from the terminal, and the CLI backs Snyk's local MCP server for coding agents. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI in agentic workflows, and evidence of machine-readable output modes for agent consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Snyk CLI brings the functionality of Snyk into your development workflow. You can run the CLI locally from the command line or in an IDE.
Snyk CLI: Run `snyk fix --agentic` from your terminal to trigger a human-in-the-loop interactive remediation experience without an IDE.
The Snyk MCP Server is designed as a local MCP server, running on your system using the Snyk CLI to ensure local file access.
To scan your source code, run `snyk code test`.
